author: Vox
description:
It’s no secret that coral reefs are struggling. By one estimate, the world has lost half of its live coral since the 1950s, and Vox’s Benji Jones has been reporting on this for a while now. But recently, he went on a reporting trip to Palau to cover a project that's trying to turn things around for coral — and is trying to do it fast.
